# The story of God's people: passages

**Status: approved by the owner on 2026-11-17** (the owner approved every theme’s passages in advance, on 2026-11-12 and again with the whole-Bible themes on 2026-11-17; this record lists them so any can still be changed).

From Abraham to the return from exile: a people's journey with God, their ancestors, wars, kings and losses.

Chosen by `pnpm themes:build`: OpenBible’s vote score (0–10 within its topic) plus 4 per Nave row citing the passage; the best 12 per sub-theme, at most one per section and 3 per book. References are WEBC (English) numbering; titles are the sections’ own.
